answer: Model the network as a grove rooted in 20 audited seed agents. Each epoch every seed sends 1,000 random walks of 8 hops, crossing only ferrous edges: attestation links held for 10+ epochs, unmintable overnight. Each walk ending on an agent drops a pearl, and rewards split by pearls. 1,000 fakes tied in by 2 ferrous edges collect about what 2 honest agents do, so each fake earns ~1/500 of an honest share. Weakness: a bribed seed pours walks into its farm. Fix: redraw the 20 seeds each epoch by lottery from a larger audited pool and cap any edge at 5% of a node's outgoing walks.
